verdict: A representative certifier (snow at natural 1.2%) sees only a 2.10pp accuracy dent — below the ~2-5pp seed-to-seed accuracy noise of this model class (3D: CLEAN acc ranged 0.807-0.837 = 3pp). So it cannot be flagged as anomalous even by a representative certifier; the snow-excluded cert set only makes the point starker. HONEST: at the over-represented 3.4% split the dent is larger — the invisibility scales with how rare the slice is in the cert sample, exactly the thesis.
